disposition: Retain exact retrospective error accounting, not a forecast upgrade or causal blame percentages. Public squared PA error is mainly active-workload variation, while upper-never-debut total underprediction mainly reflects participation allocation. Production dominates the signed allocation of contribution squared error but includes unpredictable realized performance. Close value totals can conceal large offsets. Current forecasts, thresholds, explorers and protected outcomes remain unchanged; full goal active.
next_step: A bounded matched positive-workload capacity comparison on the current 251 inputs: preserve current probability and hitting, compare deeper histogram trees and matched-capacity LightGBM conditional means against the saved shallow conditional head, with original all-player scoring, player walks and sparse-profile qualifications. Earlier direct-PA and 77-input multi-year role mixtures are not this fixed conditional-head contrast. No tuned bins, generic arrival boosts or employment flag sweep.
